content: गुच्छः .²1 A bundle, bunch (in general); गुच्छगुल्मं तु विविधम् <ls>Ms. 1. 48</ls>. .²2 A bunch of flowers, a cluster of blossoms, a clump (of trees <ab>&c.</ab>); अक्ष्णोर्निक्षिपदञ्जनं श्रवणयोस्तापिच्छगुच्छावलिम् <ls>Gīt. 11</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 48</ls>; <ls>Śi. 6. 50</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 229</ls>. .²3 The plumage of a peacock. .²4 A necklace of pearls (in general). .²5 A pearl necklace of 32 (or, according to some, of 70) strings; <ls>Kau. A. 2. 11</ls>.
